description: Cheap Agent: SessionStart adds a one-line pointer to the delegate tool; the edit guard (edits and Bash file writes) is off until /cheapag:hook on; after a cheapag FAIL or PARTIAL, Claude hands the step to a Sonnet subagent (or, with takeover: self, its own calls are capped at limits.takeover_calls), and after an OK it does not re-run tests. Shell tests keep both free while unused.

hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && { [ -f "$r/.cheapag/hook.json" ] || [ -f "$r/.cheapag/hook/takeover" ]; } && npx -y --package=git+https://github.com/Zzmes/cheap-ag.git#feat/bigmodel-worker cheapag hook guard; exit 0
